reference.title: Cost Management dataset schema index and per-agreement cost and usage details file schemas
reference.authoritative_column_list_note: Microsoft publishes an authoritative COLUMN NAME LIST and column ORDER per agreement type and dataset version (see sets below). Microsoft does NOT publish, for the classic cost details dataset, any per-column data type, nullability, unit of measure, timestamp format, or allowed-value enumeration. Column names are therefore verified; every other attribute is not-published.

columns.name: meterRegion
columns.description: The name of the Azure region associated with the meter. It generally aligns with the resource location, except for certain global meters that are shared across regions. In such cases, the meter region indicates the primary region of the meter. The meter is used to track the usage of specific services or resources, mainly for billing purposes. Each Azure service, resource, and region have its own billing meter ID that precisely reflects how its consumption and price are calculated.
